typefaces.name: Lastik
typefaces.role: Sets page and section headings. Regular is the only cut we ship, so never fake a bold or an italic.

typefaces.name: GeneralSans
typefaces.role: Carries body copy, interface text and labels. A variable font, so any weight from 200 to 600 is available.

logos.usage: The default. Use it wherever the brand appears first.

logos.name: Icon, white
logos.usage: The app icon on dark surfaces.

logos.name: Glyph
logos.usage: The mark alone, without the container.

logos.name: Wordmark
logos.usage: The name alone. Use when the mark already appears nearby.

usageRules: Keep clear space around the logo equal to the height of the mark.
Do not rotate, stretch, recolor or add effects to the logo.
Never place the dark logo on a dark surface. Use the white variant.
Below 24px, use the glyph rather than the full lockup.
Use the supplied files. Do not redraw the mark or reset the wordmark.
